title: Listen to a Conversation：两个人把一件事谈定
goal: 一段对话只听一遍，后面两题都答对：听出是谁在办什么事、卡在哪、最后怎么定的，习语和言外之意靠对方的反应来懂。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 听力

points.label: 事情卡在哪、最后怎么定的：细节不听反
习语、言外之意、接下来会做什么

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Test 2026 Update — Test Blueprint and Specifications
sources.used: 题量、难度范围、录音长度、只放一遍

sources.title: ETS：TOEFL iBT Listening Lesson Plans（教师用教案）
sources.used: 第 1 课：四类题的说明和小测答案；第 2、4 课：应答配对、重音和语调

rows.v: 听力部分四类题之一，10 题，也就是五段对话，每段两题。
rows.src: spec 第 4 页；lessonplan 第 7 页

rows.v: 两个人之间的一段短对话。话题是公共生活里的事：吃饭、社交活动、学业、娱乐、各种服务、健康、爱好、住处、购物、通讯、出行。
听出对话的主要内容和场合；重要细节；熟练说话人会用的各种语法结构；较广的词汇，包括习语和口语说法；推断没有明说的意思；一句话的用意；对说话人接下来的行动作简单的预测；跟上两个人一来一往之间的联系。
这类题要的不只是听出每个词：还要能推断、能认出说话人的身份和目的、能作预测。
官方标的范围是 A2 到 C1。
47 题，约 29 分钟，分两段自适应。每段录音只放一遍。说话人有北美、英国、澳大利亚三种口音。
rows.src: spec 第 1、4、11 页；overview 第 8 页；lessonplan 第 7 页

cards.title: 这类对话的走向

steps.t: 一　开头一两句：谁找谁，要办什么
steps.d: I'd like to borrow ...、Can I return ...、Do you have a minute?。听到这里就知道场合和目的。
几乎每段都有一个障碍：时间冲突、名额满了、不符合条件。信号是 but、though、I'm afraid、By six?（把对方的话重复一遍并上扬）。
对方给一两个办法：In that case, you could ...、I can offer ...、or you could ...。
I'll go with that.、Store credit is fine.、Then please put my name down.。最后的决定常常直接出一道题。

cards.note: 「接下来会做什么」的题，答案几乎总在最后两句里。

cards.title: 四种问法
rows: Why can't the student ...? / What does the clerk offer?
卡住的那一句，以及紧跟着的解释。
What does Jo mean when she says “...”? / Why does the man say “...”?
看这句话前后：对方刚说了什么，之后怎么接。
把两句话合起来：名额快满了，加上今天交表就有。意思是要快。
What will the student probably do next?
cards.src: 官方样题的两道题正是言外之意和一句话的用意，见 lessonplan 第 4 页。

cards.title: 对话里常见的习语
cards.intro: 官方明确说听力不回避习语，样题里就有一句 I'd forget my head if it wasn't screwed on。听到不认识的说法，看对方怎么接。
rows: I'm up to my ears in work.
That'll work. / That works for me.
我了解自己（后面多半是一个推辞的理由）。
cards.src: 官方不回避习语的说明，见 lessonplan 第 7 页。

cards.title: 错项的三种样子
rows: 对话里先说六点还，后来改成第二天早上还。选项：Return it at six.
听到 instead、in that case、though，前面的方案就作废了。
把店员提的办法说成是学生提的
slipped my mind 解释成改了主意
看后一句：I'll check the website now，说明是忘了买。

lines.text: Hi, I'd like to borrow one of the library's laptops for the afternoon.
Sure. I just need your student ID. They're due back at the desk by six.
By six? My class doesn't end until six thirty.
In that case, you could take an overnight loan instead. It has to be back by nine tomorrow morning.
That's perfect. I'll go with that.

items.stem: Why can't the student return the laptop by six?
options: She has a class that ends later.
She needs it for a class tomorrow.
items.why: By six? My class doesn't end until six thirty。

items.stem: What will the student probably do?
options: Come back after class to borrow one
Borrow a laptop until the next morning
Use a laptop in the library
items.why: 对方提出 overnight loan，她说 That's perfect. I'll go with that。六点还是被否掉的方案。

lines.text: Carla, are you free on Saturday? A few of us are driving out to the lake.
I'd love to, Nina, but I'm up to my ears in work. My history paper is due Monday, and I've barely started.
That's too bad. We're leaving early, though. You could write in the evening.
Tempting, but I know myself. If I go, I won't write a word. Take some pictures for me.
Will do. Next time, then.

items.stem: What does Carla mean when she says she is “up to my ears in work”?
options: She has a great deal of work to do.
items.why: 下一句就是解释：论文周一要交，还没怎么动。

items.stem: What will Carla probably do on Saturday?
options: Go to the lake in the evening
Stay home and work on her paper
items.why: 她说去了就一个字也写不出来，请对方替她拍照：她不去。

lines.text: Excuse me, I bought this textbook last week, but I've dropped the course. Can I return it?
Do you have the receipt? And is the plastic wrap still on?
I have the receipt, but I opened it to check the first chapter.
Then I can't give you a full refund, I'm afraid. I can offer store credit, or you could sell it at the buyback table in May.
Store credit is fine. I need notebooks anyway.

items.stem: Why can't the student get a full refund?
options: She bought the book too long ago.
She is still taking the course.
items.why: 店员问塑封还在不在，她说拆开看过第一章，店员接着说不能全额退。

items.stem: What will the student probably do next?
options: Wait until May to sell the book
Accept store credit and buy supplies
items.why: Store credit is fine. I need notebooks anyway。

lines.text: Professor Lin, do you have a minute? I'm thinking about switching from the Tuesday lab to the Thursday one.
Is there a problem with Tuesday?
My new job at the bookstore runs until three on Tuesdays, and the lab starts at two.
I see. Thursday is nearly full, but one student dropped this morning. If you fill in the form today, the seat is yours.
I'll do it right after this. Thank you so much.

items.stem: Why does the student want to change labs?
options: Her work hours overlap with the Tuesday lab.
The Tuesday lab is too difficult.
She does not like her lab partner.
items.why: 工作到三点，实验两点开始。

options: The Thursday lab may be canceled.
The student should quit her job.
items.why: Thursday is nearly full，而且 If you fill in the form today, the seat is yours。

lines.text: Jo, did you get the tickets for Friday's concert?
Oh no. It completely slipped my mind. I'll check the website now.
I hope they're not sold out.
Looks like there are a few left in the balcony. They're a bit more expensive, though.
Balcony's fine. Just get them before they're gone, and I'll pay you back tonight.

items.stem: What does Jo mean when she says “It completely slipped my mind”?
options: She forgot to buy the tickets.
She did not want to go.
items.why: 紧接着她说现在去网站上看。

items.stem: What will Jo probably do next?
options: Ask Maya to buy the tickets
items.why: Balcony's fine. Just get them before they're gone。

lines.text: Hi, I'd like to sign up for the swimming class on Monday evenings.
Monday's class is full, but there's still space on Wednesday at the same time. Same instructor, too.
Hmm, I have a study group on Wednesdays. Is there a waiting list for Monday?
There is. You'd be third on it if I add you now. People often drop out after the first week.
Then please put my name down.

items.stem: Why doesn't the student take the Wednesday class?
options: She has another commitment that day.
items.why: I have a study group on Wednesdays。教练是同一个人。

items.stem: What does the staff member imply about the Monday class?
options: It is too difficult for beginners.
items.why: People often drop out after the first week：排在候补第三位也有希望。

lines.text: Sam, have you had a chance to look at the slides I sent?
I skimmed them on the bus, Priya. The data section is great, but the introduction feels a bit long.
I thought so too. Could you cut it down? You're better at that than I am.
Sure. I'll trim it to two slides and send it back by tonight.
Perfect. Then all we have left is the practice run on Thursday.

items.stem: What does Sam think of the slides?
items.why: The data section is great, but the introduction feels a bit long。
I'll trim it to two slides and send it back by tonight。排练是周四。

lines.text: Hi, I locked myself out of my room, and my roommate's away until Sunday.
You're in luck. We keep spare keys here. I just need to see a photo ID.
My ID is in the room, though. Would my library card do? It has my picture on it.
That'll work. Sign here, and remember to bring the key back within twenty-four hours, or there's a ten-dollar fee.

items.stem: What does the staff member mean by “You're in luck”?
options: The student has won a prize.
The problem can be solved easily.
items.why: 后一句：We keep spare keys here。

items.stem: What must the student do to avoid a fee?
options: Return the spare key within a day
items.why: bring the key back within twenty-four hours, or there's a ten-dollar fee。
